preprocessing.feature_order: 176 cell-voltage sensors followed by 32 temperature sensors
preprocessing.relative_transform: row sensor value minus same-row sensor-family mean

stage2.role: fault type classification after Stage-1 NG detection

limitations: The first 99 rows are warm-up rows and do not receive a model decision.
NG augmentation was derived from Test05-Test09, so reported internal scores are not independent external validation.
Suspect sensors are deviation-ranked candidates, not direct model attribution.
